reason: Rising-rate thesis is about to be validated by the expected 25bps FOMC hike (83-90% priced in). Value/dividend/energy positioning captures the macro setup: energy sector (+0.48%, +32% YTD) benefits from geopolitical supply constraints and AI infrastructure demand; financial sector (JPM, BRK.B) positioned to benefit from higher net interest margins; dividend and value equities (SCHD, VTV, VYM) typically outperform in rising-rate environment. Although currently underperforming SPY by 1.90% (0.47% vs 2.37%), the thesis is sound and about to be validated. Holding avoids whipsaw volatility around the event, preserves capital, and allows rate-driven outperformance to unfold.
